title: Reign of the Black Empire is Hearthstone's grittiest expansion yet

blocks.text: Hearthstone’s latest expansion latest expansion, Reign of the Black Empire is officially live!

The expansion adds 135 cards and introduces Assemble, a new keyword that allows players to create custom minions. It also brings the four Old Gods, C’Thun, Yogg-Saron, N’Zoth, and Y’Shaarj, back at the height of their power as they go on an all-out war against Aman’Thul and the rest of the Titans.
New rewards system ties purchases to in-game items

One of the update’s additions is Tavern Rewards, a system that lets players earn Tavern Tender from eligible purchases in the Hearthstone Battle.net Shop. Players can redeem the currency through the Tavern Rewards Vault for a rotating selection of rewards, including card packs, Signature cards, card backs, and hero skins.

The update also refreshes the game’s Rewards Track with the arrival of Reign of the Black Empire. Players who purchase the Tavern Pass and reach level 100 can claim the Diamond Rajh card. Each class will also receive a new deck recipe featuring cards from the expansion, alongside a Core card deck and a deck built around cards from Escape from Violet Hold, the prior expansion.

Meanwhile, Journey, a new feature in the Hearthstone Journal, brings expansion stories, quests, rewards, and seasonal activities together in one place. Players can follow the narrative through voiced vignettes and lore entries, complete Journey Quests, and earn rewards as the expansion progresses. All you lore enjoyers out there should definitely check this out.

While this expansion isn’t the first time, Hearthstone gets these Old Gods as playable cards the setting of The Black Empire predates the world most Warcraft players know. Before the rise of its kingdoms and civilizations, the Old Gods spread their influence across Azeroth, establishing a corrupted domain and commanding armies of servants. The Titans eventually sent their Titan-forged creations to oppose them, leading to the defeat of the Black Empire and the imprisonment of the surviving Old Gods.
In Reign of the Black Empire, players can pledge allegiance to only one of the four Old Gods in their deck to unlease their power.
Alongside the Old Gods, the expansion introduces Assemble, a keyword that lets players create custom minions by combining card text from different minions within a curated pool.

The mechanic fits the setting. As the Old Gods build their armies and the Titan-forged prepare to oppose them, players can construct their own forces using combinations that would not ordinarily appear on a single card. Assemble adds another layer of experimentation to deck-building, with the available combinations giving players room to pursue different strategies.
Diablo crossover and Old Gods cosmetics arrive in November

Blizzard is also preparing a Diablo crossover to mark 30 years of the franchise. The limited-time event runs from November 10 to December 1, offering rewards that include card packs, random Rare and Epic cards, Treasure Fiend cards, and the Dark Wanderer Warlock hero skin.

The Dark Wanderer Tavern Brawl returns from November 10 to 18. Players will build a Wild deck and face increasingly difficult encounters before confronting Diablo himself. Completing the Brawl awards one Reign of the Black Empire pack.

The expansion’s Old Gods will also feature prominently in Darkmoon Faire Treasures. A C’Thun Signature bundle runs from October 20 to December 1, while a transforming Y’Shaarj Mythic hero skin for Priest and Shaman becomes available from October 23. Players can also obtain an N’Zoth pet beginning November 3, with unlockable appearances and animations tied to its progression.
Collecting all four Old Gods from the expansion unlocks a Golden expansion pack, while collecting all four Signature versions awards an exclusive animated card back featuring the quartet.

The update also includes a new Legendary Quest Chain running from October 23 to November 3, rewarding players with a regular and a Golden Reign of the Black Empire pack for completing Ranked Standard games.
Patch 37.0 includes several bug fixes across Hearthstone, Battlegrounds, and cosmetics, addressing card interactions, combat stalls, and a missing voice line for the Dino Cloner Zerek hero skin.
